players.bio: Abu Bakarr Kamara (born 21 July 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Club career Kamara joined the youth academy of Norwich City at the age of ten, and worked his way up their youth categories.

Adrian Segecic (born 1 June 2004) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for English EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Segecic spent most of his youth years with Lidcombe Waratah and Parramatta FC before joining Sydney FC in October 2016. He has represented Australia at youth level since 2019.
Ben Killip (born 24 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Portsmouth.

Benjamin Kristian Arthur is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for EFL Championship club Portsmouth, on loan from Premier League club Brentford. Arthur is a product of the Peterborough United academy and began his professional career with Brentford in 2023. He has been capped by England at youth level.
Colby David Bishop (born 4 November 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Portsmouth.

Connor Stuart Ogilvie (born 14 February 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back or centre back for Portsmouth. Ogilvie started his career in Tottenham Hotspur's academy since July 2012.

Conor Glynn Shaughnessy (born 30 June 1996) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for League One team Portsmouth. Shaughnessy started his career at Reading, he joined the club in 2012 after a successful trial and he signed his first professional contract with the club in the summer of 2013.
Daniel Bielica is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.

Ebrima "Ebou" Adams (born 15 January 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Born in England, he plays for the Gambia national team. He began his career at Conference National club Dartford, before gaining regular football and attracting interest from Football League clubs while on loan at Walton Casuals.

Eoin Kenny is a 20-year-old professional footballer from Northern Ireland who plays as a forward or right winger for English EFL Championship club Portsmouth. On 6 July 2026, he completed a high-profile transfer from League of Ireland Premier Division side Dundalk, signing a three-year contract running until June 2029.
Franco Umeh-Chibueze (born 26 February 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as winger or forward for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.
Harvey Antonio Blair (born 14 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.
Iyad Inomse M'Vourani Mohamed is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Born in France, he plays for the Comoros national team.

Jacob Brett Farrell (born 19 November 2002) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a left back for Portsmouth. Farrell was called up to the Australian under-23 side for the 2022 AFC U-23 Asian Cup in June 2022.
Jayden Ade Trindade Meghoma (born 28 June 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Portsmouth, on loan from Premier League club Brentford.
John Michael Lewis Mousinho (born 30 April 1986) is a former English professional footballer. He is the chairman of the Professional Footballers' Association (PFA), and the Head Coach of Portsmouth.

John David Swift (born 23 June 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL Championship club Portsmouth. He has been described as a "box-to-box player who is technically gifted with an eye for goal" and is a current England U21 international.

Joshua Murphy (born 24 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Portsmouth. He began his career at Norwich City, for whom he scored on his professional debut for in a League Cup match against Watford, and later played for Cardiff City.

Keshi Stuart Oluyinka Adetokunboh Anderson is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger and striker for Portsmouth. After playing youth football with Watford and non-League football with Barton Rovers, Anderson turned professional with Crystal Palace in 2015.
Luke Joseph Brooke-Smith is a New Zealand footballer who plays as a left winger for EFL Championship club Portsmouth and the New Zealand national team.
Madiodio ‘Jojo’ Dia is a Senegalese footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.
Márk Kosznovszky (born 17 April 2002) is a Hungarian footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.
Marko Milovanović, sometimes known as Marezi, is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.

Marlon Pack (born 25 March 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Portsmouth. He formerly played for Bristol City, Portsmouth and Cheltenham Town. Born in Portsmouth, Hampshire, Pack became a first year scholar in the 2007–08 season playing regularly for the academy and occasionally for the reserves.
Nicolas Schmid (born 22 February 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Championship side Portsmouth.
Odin Ohray Bailey is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Portsmouth.

Regan Poole is a Welsh footballer who plays as a centre back for EFL Championship club Portsmouth and the Wales national team. Poole was a member of the Cardiff City academy and joined the Newport County Academy as a scholar in June 2014. In September 2014, he was on trial at Manchester United before he had made his debut for the Newport County senior team.

Rocco Robert Shein is an Estonian professional footballer who plays as midfielder for EFL Championship club Portsmouth and the Estonia national team. Shein made his debut for the Estonia national football team on 13 June 2022 in a friendly against Albania.

Ryan Denis Edward Kavuma-McQueen (born 1 January 2009) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Portsmouth, on loan from Chelsea. Early life Kavuma-McQueen was born on 1 January 2009 at Hammersmith Hospital in White City, London. Born in England, he is of Ugandan descent through his parents.
Terry Devlin (born 6 November 2003) is a Northern Irish footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Portsmouth as a midfielder.
Thomas Waddingham (born 5 April 2005) is an Australian soccer player who plays as a striker for Portsmouth.

Tyrese James Shade (born 9 June 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Born in England, he represents the Saint Kitts and Nevis national team. Born in Birmingham, Shade began his career with Solihull Moors before joining Leicester City in 2017. In August 2021 he moved on loan to Walsall.

Zachary "Zak" Swanson (born 28 September 2000) is an English footballer who currently plays as a right-back for Portsmouth . Club career Born in Cambridge, Swanson joined Arsenal at the age of 6 and signed his first professional contract with the club in April 2019. In August 2020, Swanson joined Dutch Eerste Divisie side MVV Maastricht on a season-long loan deal.
